title: Enrolment search input + API search support
content:
Add text search to the enrolments admin page.

## API change: GET /api/admin/enrolments
- Add optional `search` query param
- Query against user.nameEn, user.nameZh, user.email, user.idDocNumber, user.iaLicense using Prisma `contains` + `mode: 'insensitive'`
- Keep existing `status`, `page`, `limit` params

## UI change: src/app/[locale]/admin/enrolments/page.tsx
- Add search input above the table, alongside status filter tabs
- Debounce input (300ms) to reduce API calls
- Show a clear (×) button when search is active
- Persist search term in URL query param so pagination preserves search
- Visual: search icon + placeholder from dict (keys already exist: search, searchPlaceholder)

States:
- Empty: show search placeholder
- Loading: spinner while search is debounced/fetching
- No results: show empty message with hint to adjust search term
- Results: filtered list with pagination

No batch keys needed — those go in AD-006-BATCH.
